facts.text: Wilmington College features an expansive 267-acre Academic Farm with farm animals, greenhouses, and a 2.5-acre vegetable garden for hands-on learning.

sources.title: Agriculture Major - Wilmington College
sources.quote: Across 267 acres of land, you will find farm animals, greenhouses, a 2.5-acre vegetable garden and a 1,300-gallon rainwater recycling system.
